Definition: properly, to breathe freely, i.e. revive; by implication, to have ample room
BiblicalUsage: 1) to be wide, be spacious, breathe; 1a) (Qal) to breathe easily, be relieved; 1b) (Pual) spacious (participle)
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
